user.title: Lotto 6/45 Analysis
user.description: Analyze Lotto 6/45 history using the release-bundled snapshot and a shared GitHub mirror, then create selectable recommendation games.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Lotto 6/45 Analysis instance can be configured.

init.title: Recommendation methods, personal Four Pillars, AI, and data source
init.description: All settings are shown on one screen. If Personal Four Pillars is selected, fill every [Saju] required field below before saving. If it is not selected, those fields may be left empty.

data.ai_task_entity_id: AI Task entity (optional; blank uses the preferred data AI Task)
data.ai_auto_generate: Automatically generate AI recommendation for a new draw
data.allow_official_direct_fallback: Allow limited direct Donghaeng Lottery fallback

data_description.selected_methods: Multiple methods can be selected. When Personal Four Pillars is selected, provide calendar, birth date/time, gender, birth place and timezone in the [Saju] fields below. None of these methods changes the mathematical winning probability.
data_description.saju_birth_date: Required only when the Personal Four Pillars method is selected.
data_description.saju_birth_time: Required only when the Personal Four Pillars method is selected.
data_description.saju_birth_place: Required only when the Personal Four Pillars method is selected. No external geocoding request is made.
data_description.saju_timezone: For births in Korea, Asia/Seoul is normally used.
data_description.saju_lunar_leap_month: Used only for a lunar-calendar birth date.
data_description.saju_true_solar_time: When enabled, the hour pillar time is corrected using timezone meridian, longitude and equation of time.
data_description.saju_longitude: Only needed when true solar time correction is enabled.
data_description.enable_ai_recommendation: AI is independent from local methods. Manual Refresh / Regenerate does not regenerate the AI recommendation.
data_description.ai_auto_generate: Only generates AI automatically when a new official draw is detected. Manual local regeneration suppresses AI generation.
data_description.allow_official_direct_fallback: Only used when the shared mirror is unavailable. It can fetch at most a tiny recent gap, uses sequential rate-limited requests, and never crawls the full history. Keep this disabled unless needed.

error.select_at_least_one: Select at least one recommendation method.
error.invalid_saju_profile: Personal Four Pillars is selected, but the required [Saju] birth profile is missing or invalid.
error.options_error: An error occurred while processing the options. Check the entered values and try again.
